{{Quote|A planetary shield envelops the planet, projected from the small moon orbiting it. This is our first objective. Anakin will lead a strike force on the Thule Moon to take out the shield generator.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Game" />}}
During the [[Battle of Thule]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was tasked with powering down a '''shield generator complex''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sivvi]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thule/Legends|Thule]]. The shield prevented any assault on Thule, and was kept operational via charger couplings spread around the perimeter of the generator.

==Description==
The generator itself was mounted on an elevated base with four charger couplings arranged around the perimeter of the base. Inside were [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] for defensive measures, along with an array of [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|spider droids]], [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|AATs]], [[Ground Armored Tank|GATs]], [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|Hailfire droids]], and [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 droid enforcers]].<ref name="CWPOSG">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

Outside the walled facility were two tower [[Laser turret/Legends|turrets]] guarding the gate. Several [[Meter/Legends|meters]] out were four platforms, two on each side, extending over deep craters with [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]] positioned on them.<ref name="CWPOSG" />

==History==
[[File:Sivvi_shield_generator_complex.png|thumb|left|250px|The Sivvi shield generator complex]]
With [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] rapidly converging in on the system, the campaign was split into three phases. Skywalker spearheaded the first phase, in which his [[Bravo Squadron (Republic)|forces]] were tasked with landing on the moon and eliminating the generator so that it would allow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces to deploy on Thule. Upon landing from an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]], Skywalker's task force was promptly detected by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] and fiercely engaged by waves of droid craft.<ref name="Game" />

With the initial waves defeated, a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Republic Troop Transport/Legends|Republic Troop Transports]] carrying [[clone engineer]]s debarked from the assault ship and began their course for the complex. Skywalker, accompanied by his squadmates [[Bravo 3 (clone trooper)|Bravo 3]] and [[Bravo 4 (clone trooper)|Bravo 4]], mobilized to escort the transports along the way - meeting heavy resistance and losing at least [[Convoy 1|one]] convoy unit along the way to enemy [[Heavy Artillery Gun|artillery]].<ref name="Game" />

Reaching the perimeter, the engineers breached the wall of the facility, allowing Skywalker inside with his [[All Terrain Experimental Transport]]. Dispatching groups of spider droids, AATs and turrets, Skywalker blasted his way through several walls in his path before navigating through a decline that brought him into view of the charger couplings. Separatist forces attempted to stop his onslaught with additional tanks and hailfire droids, but failed to do so. Following the destruction of all four charger couplings, the generator ceased enveloping Thule with its protective shield - completing the first phase of the mission. Republic forces in the area then departed for Thule to join [[Jedi Master/Legends|masters]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-wan Kenobi]].<ref name="Game" />
